# AeroStator Model Access and Non-Disclosure Agreement

**DRAFT. Version {{version}}. Not for production use until approved by MOTRES's patent attorney.**
If this text differs from the Chinese version, this English text prevails.

**Parties.** MOTRES d.o.o., registration no. 7255691000, Kotnikova 34, 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia ("MOTRES"); and **{{company}}**, registration no. {{reg_no}}, {{country}}, {{address}} (the "Recipient"), represented by {{signatory}}, {{title}}, e-mail {{email}}. Accepted online on {{date}}.

**1. Definitions**

1.1 "App" means the AeroStator web application at aerostator.com. "Software" means the AeroStator software published under the Apache License 2.0.

1.2 "AeroStator Core Technology" means the AeroStator Core permanent-magnet machine technology (designs, geometries, methods and know-how), whether or not it is covered by patents or patent applications owned by MOTRES or by its licensors. MOTRES holds the right to use it and to sublicense it.

1.3 "Confidential Information" means all non-public information that MOTRES makes available to the Recipient under this Agreement, in particular downloaded 3-D models (STEP files), drawings, dimensions, bills of materials (BOM), production and test data, and anything marked or obviously confidential. Each file carries the Recipient's name and the download date, and downloads are logged. The Recipient shall not remove or alter these marks.

1.4 "Purpose" means evaluating the motors, integrating them into the Recipient's own products, and ordering motors from MOTRES.

**2. Use and protection**

The Recipient shall use the Confidential Information only for the Purpose, protect it with at least the care it gives its own most sensitive information (and never less than reasonable care), and tell MOTRES without delay of any unauthorised use or disclosure.

**3. What the Recipient must not do**

Without a written licence from MOTRES, the Recipient shall not, and shall not allow anyone else to:

(a) manufacture or have manufactured motors, stators, rotors, coils or laminations from or using the Confidential Information, or using the AeroStator Core Technology;

(b) reverse engineer, decompile or otherwise derive the design, dimensions, materials, winding or manufacturing process of AeroStator Core machines from the Confidential Information or, as far as the law allows, from any motor or sample supplied by MOTRES;

(c) file, or help to file, any patent, utility model or design application that is based on, discloses or uses the Confidential Information, or that claims the AeroStator Core Technology;

(d) disclose the Confidential Information to any third party. The only exception is the Recipient's employees, contractors and professional advisers who need it for the Purpose and are bound in writing by duties at least as strict as these; the Recipient is liable for them. No manufacturer of motors or motor parts may receive it for manufacturing.

This clause does not stop the Recipient from buying, using and integrating motors supplied by MOTRES, or from protecting its own products and inventions that neither use nor disclose the Confidential Information or the AeroStator Core Technology.

**4. No licence**

4.1 This Agreement grants no licence or right, express or implied, under any patent, patent application, know-how, copyright or trademark of MOTRES or its licensors, including the marks "AeroStator" and "AeroStator Core". Viewing or rotating a model in the App also grants none.

4.2 The Software is licensed under Apache-2.0 on its own terms. That licence covers the Software only. It gives no right to manufacture AeroStator Core machines or to practise the AeroStator Core Technology. Nothing in this Agreement reduces the rights Apache-2.0 gives in the Software itself.

**5. Exceptions**

Clauses 2 and 3(d) do not apply to information that the Recipient shows by written records (a) is or becomes public without the Recipient's fault, (b) it lawfully held before disclosure, (c) it developed independently without using the Confidential Information, or (d) it lawfully received from a third party free to disclose it. Clauses 3(a) to 3(c) still apply to the AeroStator Core Technology as such. If the law, a court or an authority requires disclosure, the Recipient may disclose only what is required, after notifying MOTRES where lawful.

**6. Term, return and remedies**

6.1 This Agreement starts on acceptance and covers every file the Recipient downloads while it is in force. MOTRES may suspend or end the Recipient's access at any time; the Recipient may end it by written notice.

6.2 The Recipient's obligations continue for five (5) years after its last download. Information that is a trade secret stays protected for as long as it remains a trade secret under applicable law.

6.3 On MOTRES's request, or when this Agreement ends, the Recipient shall promptly delete or destroy all Confidential Information and copies, including those held by its contractors, and confirm this in writing within fourteen (14) days. Backup copies that cannot be removed at once, and copies the law requires it to keep, stay subject to this Agreement. Documents that MOTRES delivers under a separate written agreement or with an order are governed by that agreement.

6.4 Unauthorised use or disclosure may cause harm that money cannot repair, so MOTRES may seek injunctive relief from any competent court, in addition to other remedies. The Recipient is liable for the damage caused by its breach.

6.5 Confidential Information is provided "as is" without warranty. The Recipient must verify dimensions and data before relying on them. MOTRES is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, except for intent or gross negligence.

**7. Export control**

The Recipient shall comply with all applicable export control, sanctions and trade laws, and shall not pass the Confidential Information to any sanctioned person or country.

**8. Electronic acceptance**

8.1 The Recipient accepts this Agreement by entering its company data, ticking the acceptance box and typing the signatory's name. This is a simple electronic signature within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS) and has the same effect as a handwritten signature to the extent the law allows. The Recipient shall not contest this Agreement for being electronic.

8.2 The signatory confirms that he or she has read this Agreement, that the data entered is correct, that he or she is authorised to bind the company named above, and that the company acts in the course of its business. If the signatory is not so authorised, the signatory is personally bound.

8.3 MOTRES keeps an acceptance record: version, hash of the text shown (SHA-256), date and time (UTC), IP address, user account, the data entered and the download log. The Parties agree that this record is evidence of the acceptance and of the text accepted. A PDF copy of the accepted Agreement is sent to the Recipient's e-mail above and to MOTRES.

8.4 MOTRES processes the signatory's and user's data and IP address to conclude, perform and prove this Agreement, and keeps them for as long as claims may arise from it.

8.5 MOTRES may publish a new version of this Agreement. A new version applies only to files downloaded after the Recipient accepts it.

**9. General**

9.1 This Agreement is the whole agreement on its subject. A separate written agreement signed by MOTRES prevails over it where they conflict. 9.2 The Recipient may not assign this Agreement without MOTRES's written consent; MOTRES may assign it to a successor or licensor. 9.3 If a provision is invalid, the rest stays in force and the closest valid provision replaces it. 9.4 Changes, other than under clause 8.5, need written form. 9.5 Notices go by e-mail to the addresses in the acceptance record. 9.6 This Agreement is made in English; translations are for convenience only.
